pages: Rumor has it there are demons on the roads... so be careful.
Headed to Kyoto, are you? All right, go on through...
397.question: Pass through Iga Checkpoint?

pages: Hey! Old lady...
Excuse me... traveler...
...There's nothing for you outside, you know!
Did you enjoy your meal? Please come again!
Recovered some health!
Have you heard?
They say the one to rule the land after Lord Hideyoshi...
...will be Lord Tokugawa Ieyasu! Everyone's saying so!
In the name of justice... OK! Let's defeat Mizuki together!
Oh? And you are...?
Did you need Lady Bizuki? It seems she isn't here.
Still, what lovely weather we're having today...
You've come... Are you ready?
She was here just a moment ago... Maybe she's with the priest?
Anything else you need?
Sorry, but you ain't got enough money.
How much should I work on it?
There ya go, all done!
What do you want?
Anything else?
Which one'll it be?
Nobody can equip that!
Want to equip it?
Who's gonna equip it?
Which one are you taking off?
You can't carry any more money!
You ain't got anything to sell.
Hmph...
Playing with Mizuki would be fun, but there's a man I have to cut down...
Jesus... What the hell just happened?
How strange... Is this truly real?
Lady Bizuki told me...
...that you should use it in the Noh theater in the back.
...Someday...
When Mizuki truly runs wild, I want my child to do what I could not...
Truly, this is the land where the gods once gathered...
...Here I come!
HEY! Jubei! I've come to lend a hand!
Leave this to us, and go take care of your topknot!
I can't believe it! To think a thing like that would attack us...
My daughter... give me back my daughter! Why did she have to die?!
My daughter... Give her back to meee!
It seems he sensed this demon fortress appearing...
...and went in ahead of us...
Look at this charm... It belongs to Nicotine...
{NAME}...
We must steel ourselves before we storm this fortress...
Are you prepared...?
429.question: Storm the demon fortress?

pages: Are you ready to storm the demon fortress?
430.question: Storm the demon fortress?

pages: Hmm... caution is only natural.
I'll keep watch here, so go and make your preparations!
But we haven't much... time!
Now then, we are about to storm this demon fortress...
But before that, {NAME}, there is something I need you to do.
...And that is to go out on June 27th...
...and buy the CD of Shinsetsu Samurai Spirits: Bushido Retsuden!
Buy it, I say!
...So that's how it is. Got it, Jubei!
So the rest of the story is in Bushido Retsuden, out June 27th!
I understand, Master Jubei. Mizuki's plot to defile nature...
...I will stop it in Bushido Retsuden, on sale June 27th!
ALL RIGHT! Gotcha, Jubei!
The rest of our adventure is in Bushido Retsuden, out June 27th!
...That's the deal, right?
I see... So if one buys Bushido Retsuden on June 27th...
...one will be able to defeat Mizuki...
Hmph... nonsense!
You expect me to wait until Bushido Retsuden comes out June 27th...
...just to kill Mizuki?!
Really?!
So we can keep going in Bushido Retsuden, out June 27th!
Indeed... That's how it is.
Save up your allowance until June 27th and wait!
And no cheating on us with other games!
Uwahahahahaha!
Aww, sorry! We're all sold out of Izumo soba.
With all the demons around lately, we can't get ingredients.
A good weapon's no use without the skill to wield it...
If you want stronger weapons, train hard and hone your sword arm.
I sure love soba!
Eatin' soba gives me lots of energy!
So you mean to fight the demons too, eh...
Then first things first, you'll want medicinal herbs...
We're buyin' arms to get ready for the demons too!
If you buy gear and 'equip' it...
...even us folks can get as strong as samurai!
I wanna fight demons too! Let me join ya!
444.question: Let Shinbei join the party?

pages: Really? Yahoo!
Shinbei joined the party!
Will I get as popular as you...
...and get fans sendin' drawings of me to game magazines?
Will gals cosplay as me and come to Neo Geo Land?
...Sorry. Maybe I'll pass after all.
I can't even beat my old lady at home...
Shinbei went back to being a farmer...
Doubtin' my skills, are ya? I'm the best hoe-swinger in Izumo!
For strong folks like you...
...maybe it's better to buy herbs before buyin' gear.
Will you be fighting the demons too?
If you like, please take the arms over there.
I'd be happy if those arms are of even a little help...
Something bad's going on!
{NAME}! Let's go after Jubei!
...Something terrible has come to Izumo!
We must go after Master Jubei too!
This doesn't look like any ordinary thing...
{NAME}! Let's head outside too!
...I have a bad feeling about this. Let us follow Jubei!
Wh-what's goin' on?
{NAME}! I dunno what's happenin', but...
...let's go after Mister Jubei anyway!
...This is bad. That was no ordinary earthquake...
...We should go outside as well!
What?! So even that Kubira demon was merely the opening act...
Let us go after Jubei as well!
...Something feels... strange... really strange!
Master Jubei is in danger! We have to go after him!
Buha buha! I'd heard the souls of fools who defy the demon realm...
...were tasty... Buhahaha! And they're exquisite!
Now that I've eaten, shall I crush this grand shrine?!
Izumo is ours! Lady Mizuki and Lord Agou will be delighted!
Buha buha, buhaha!
I am the head priest of this Izumo Grand Shrine.
A samurai went into the shrine all alone, but...
...since then, there hasn't been a peep from inside...
Some strange barrier keeps me from seeing what's going on...
I hope it's nothing serious... but I'm getting worried.
Not even my power can break this barrier. I doubt you could.
Still, I wonder if that samurai is all right...
I still don't approve of your sword!
But Genjuro... we have no time to waste!
You mean to fight the demons too, do you?
I don't think you can do it alone, you know.
It'd be wise to pick one reliable companion.
You'll be traveling in pairs for a while... Choose carefully.
But... everyone just picks the one they like, right?
That girl over there... She's pretty cute, huh?
Truth is... I've got my eye on her.
If you're picking a partner...
...pick someone with strengths you don't have!
If you rely on raw power, pick someone fast.
If you hit hard, pick someone with healing arts...
...and so on.
...Huh, me?
Heh heh... I'm still in training!
A companion for life and death... Have a good journey.
Then please choose again. And think it over carefully...
They'll be with you on a long journey.
The demons, which had been lying low for some time...
...have suddenly become very active.
So it is true... Not only the people...
...but the trees and animals of the forest are frightened too...
You're saying it's because something evil...
...has begun to stir, Master Nicotine?
You mean those guys are up to...
...something crazy again?
I see... No wonder I got...
...such a bad feeling when I arrived in Izumo!
An invasion from the demon realm... is it?
...I see. A fascinating tale indeed.
So the first step of the demons' invasion will be Izumo...
Is that what you are saying?
Oh, I see...
So the bad guys are causing trouble again!
...I have an idea who is behind this disturbance...
If my grim suspicions are correct...
...the battle ahead will be very difficult indeed.
I'm sorry to ask so much... but you can match the demons.
Won't you fight alongside this old man?
I can never forgive demons who defile nature...
I ask you too... please help Master Nicotine!
Of course I'll take the job, Master Nicotine...
Leave it to me, Galford!
No problem! Justice always wins!
...Understood. I will lend what little aid I can.
As you know, I, Ukyo...
...am traveling in search of a flower from the demon realm...
Perhaps I may find some clue while hunting demons.
Ah, Genjuro! Sorry to keep you waiting.
Now, take this with you.
I sure love soba! Eatin' soba gives me lots of energy!
Some ve-ery bad people are starting to do ve-ery bad things again.
Grandpa can't sit around eating bananas with Cham Cham now.
It's not just me... Izumo, all of Japan... no...
...eeeveryone in the whole world is scared of the demons...
That's right... So, Cham Cham...
...won't you help Grandpa...
...beat those ve-ery bad people?
Hmm... Thank you, Cham Cham...
Now then...
I'm sorry, Cham Cham...
This battle calls not merely for skill with weapons...
...but for strength of the soul...
And your innocent soul is something we truly need...
Something bad's going on!
{NAME}! Let's go after Jubei!
Mguwah!
Gebegebeh!
Silence! I shall show you the edge of my secret sword!
I don't get the logic, but basically...
...I just cut you down along with him, right?!
Hnnnngh!!
Hyah!
Seeeiyah!
Haohmaru learned the ultimate secret art...
...Tenha Kourin Zan!
Nakoruru learned the ultimate secret art...
...Nupeki Rera Shikite!
Galford learned the ultimate secret art...
...Double Mega Strike Heads!
Ukyo Tachibana learned the ultimate secret art...
...Musou Zan'ei Kou!
Genjuro Kibagami learned the ultimate secret art...
...Gokou Zan!
Cham Cham learned the ultimate secret art...
...Terum Impetus!
Charlotte learned the ultimate secret art...
...Rafale Gradation!
Kyoshiro Senryo learned the ultimate secret art...
...Orochi no Mai!
Rimururu learned the ultimate secret art...
...Rupushi Rera Emu II!
Reon of the Gale learned the ultimate secret art...
...Tensho Hououzan!
Sorry about this... An order just came down.
The port of Shimonoseki is closed for a while.
...Why? I couldn't tell you, but...
...it seems like something really big...
The bigwigs are running around in a panic.
What? I can't let you through without a pass!
What, you haven't heard?
Just the other day, an order came down from the government!
Not just Himeji... Hakone, Shimonoseki too...
Every checkpoint in Japan is sealed off!
I don't know what kind of power that is, but I don't like it!
If you don't want to get hurt, move it, Your Lordship!
I'm in a hurry here!
Inhuman power... is it?
Lord Hisamaro...
True power becomes your flesh and blood through your own training.
It is not something you can swap like a jacket.
Lord Hisamaro, it is not too late even now.
Cut all ties with Senkaku... and with the demon realm!
Hmph... I don't like it!
I've got no time to waste on the likes of you!
Get lost!
Hmph... honestly...
Seems any idiot can be a court noble.
Kyeeeh!
If fate wills it, we'll meet again!
I knew it! Great fortune after all! Kyuuin's divinations are the best!
Senkaku! Name any reward you wish! Kyohohohoho!
Hmph... Fools who cannot see reason...
To protect Kyoto, we cannot be picky. We face Mizuki herself!
What other way is there but to take in her own power?
Now! Carry their bodies to the curse altar!
We'll infuse them with dark power and use them as shikigami!
Heh heh... Samurai this strong are too good to simply kill...
We of Kyuuin will put every last hair of theirs to use!
To protect Kyoto! Uwahahahahaha!
You bet! Of course!
Hmph... naturally.
Hehe... Even Mother Nature is happy!
Yeah! Justice wins wherever it goes!
I see, so you have your own mission...
Ohhh... What a shame...!
You were the true man I finally found after traveling this land...
They say there's a village of hidden Christians near Ise...
Not that it matters or anything.
The Kyuuin onmyoji protect Kyoto, you know.
I don't really get it, but they use oni to seal away evil.
People are scared of demons, but as long as you're in Kyoto, you're safe.
How was it? Gives you energy, right?
You do feel a bit healthier...
The onmyoji who protect Kyoto are split into Kyuuin in the north...
...and Kafuin in the south.
Kafuin's the friendlier one...
...but when push comes to shove, Kyuuin's the one you count on.
That's the image most folks have, anyway.
Tasty, right? Got you nice and full, didn't it?
You feel re-energized!
We Kyoto folks don't worry about the demon trouble at all.
The onmyoji keep Kyoto perfectly safe from demons!
Ohh, thank you! I like your spirit!
He's an odd-looking fellow, but that spirit, that fight, that skill...
That's the kind of man people call a samurai.
You hardly ever see them anymore these days...
When I was young, there were plenty of them around.
You really are worried about me, aren't you...
Hey now, it was nothing... You're making me blush!
There is no need for thanks... I am truly glad.
...And so {NAME} crossed over to the mainland with Wan-Fu...
Wan-Fu began a war to unite all of China.
Wan-Fu and {NAME} fought like demon gods...
...and conquered the surrounding lands in no time at all...
And then...
Me? My name's Nozomi.
I'm helping out my dad.
Welcome! Leading tomorrow's fashion world...
...this is Kuzuhara Kimono, Kyoto main store!
For 100GP, we'll make you any outfit you like!
So, what do you say?
528.question: Get new clothes made?

pages: Well, no need to buy today...
...have a look for something to buy tomorrow.
Oh my... Not to your liking?
...Please come again sometime.
So sorry... you're a bit short on money.
I'll hold it for you, so please come back another time.
There you are, how's this?
I tailored it to fit just right. It suits you nicely.
Oh my... It looks wonderful after all.
Even the clothes seem happy to be worn by you.
I'm not used to making clothes like these...
...but I think it turned out rather well, if I say so myself.
Just as you ordered, I made it easy to move in.
Hmm... Am I getting a little stylish now?
I loved my old clothes, but these new ones are lovely too.
Wow, sis... Lucky! I want another outfit too!
You look really beautiful...
Oh, Galford...
...Thank you. You're making me blush...
New ninja clothes, but the man's still all justice!
...Thank you. Quite fine cloth for the price.
Hoh... you live up to your big talk.
...I like it.
Different color, but still Greenhell style!
Maybe... I like this one better after all...?
Oui... Exactly as I ordered.
And... the design is splendid as well.
Charlotte... you look pretty good!
Hmm...
As one would expect of the main store, the tailoring is a cut above.
Thank you very much!
All Kuzuhara stores sponsor Kyoshiro's troupe...
...so as always, you get it at half price.
Hehe! It'd be a waste to go outside in this!
Oh, Rimururu...
We're not traveling just for fun, you know!
Sorry... but... I'm just so happy!
Gonna use an item?
There ya go, done!
You've got no item for elements.
You've only got enough money for the forging.
You sure it's okay to lose the element?
You can't leave the capital! By order of Lord Ayanokouji...
...kindly turn back!
His head may be lacking, but that brute strength is something.
You're late, you lot! Damn it! Do something!
...Damn you, Mizuki!
Let's break the wheel of fate! Here we go!
Gigo! Gigo!!!!!! GGGGOOOOFFF!!!!!
Nakoruru!!!
...Reon...
...That is enough... It cannot be helped.
Reon!
...That's enough of that...
What'll we do, Haohmaru?
What'll we do, Genjuro?
Thank you! Please come again.
Do you know the name Amakusa Shiro?
From everything that has happened, this Amakusa Shiro...
...seems to hold the key to it all...
Can you tell me about this Amakusa Shiro guy too?
From what the bad guys we've beaten have been saying...
...he seems to be the big boss of evil.
Hmph... What are you so surprised about...
Spare me the chatter. Just answer my questions.
Tell me... what is the demon realm?
The demon realm...
...is a world of darkness, teeming with demons ruled by the Dark Lord.
Some say it is the darkness of this world, or a shadow in men's hearts...
...but no one truly knows.
Demons are rising all over Japan, and men sell their souls to darkness.
Of late, the demon realm's power has grown abnormally strong.
I hate to say it, but I sense dark, demonic power in you as well...
Hmph, don't lump me in with some filthy demon.
I see...
But don't be so quick to dismiss fortune-telling.
Hmm... You lack the money. Come back another time.
...You are quite aggressive. I neither blame nor praise you for it.
In times like these...
...it's only natural to be aggressive.
But other possibilities lie hidden within you as well.
Live by battle, die by battle...
Your wish will surely be granted.
You are weary of fighting...
Yet your soul still craves battle...
Truly, the hell of the Asura.
The dark path, from which there is no turning back...
But is there truly no turning back?
Memories of blood demand a new sacrifice...
Is the one you cut down your enemy... or yourself?
Hmm... A passionate soul. But can you keep this fire...
...burning until the very end?
The strength to forgive your enemies leads the way to tomorrow...
But it is a hair's breadth from betrayal.
If you are too kind, it is your own blood that must be spilled.
If you choose to go on anyway, be strong!
Never doubt your kindness!
Someday, you will be proven right!
Unbelievable!
Your soul radiates warmth!
I only hope your kindness isn't naivete.
It is hard to be both strong and kind.
So that is the path you walk.
